text:
nina: Planning a rolling reboot and node re-label for az5 next Thu. Window 23:30-01:30 UTC. Objective: refresh NIC microcode + rebalance GPU slab placement. Will do 3-node cohorts every 10 minutes.

chao: Why night window? az5 has mixed traffic but low steady-state after 00:00 UTC. Good choice.

mike: Expected capacity hit? any pinned tenants to worry about?

nina: We expect a 7% capacity dip at peak while a cohort drains. Pin tenant-ads and tenant-fin to avoid eviction. Route lower-priority batch to regional-fallback.

rachel: Canary plan? steps and abort criteria pls.

nina: Canary: cordon c-az5-canary1 -> soft-drain background queues -> run nvme + net sanity -> kv-prime -> run 100 synth queries (latency + correctness). Abort if errors >2% or p99 +250ms for 5m.

priya: Cost: could fallback spike hit dedicated pools?

nina: Small bump possible; forecast +3% GPU-minutes. Priya suggested an autoscale cap of +12% — please apply.

chao: Streaming sessions sticky? we should protect active streams.

nina: Yes. Mark active_stream=true and exempt them from drain for the cohort. New streams will route off-cohort.

mike: Runbook manual rollback?

nina: Uncordon nodes, flush KV artifacts, re-route weights back, and escalate to runtime lead. RTO target 30m.

priya: I'll set budget alert: notify if spend >5% above baseline for 10m.

rachel: Staging dry-run?

nina: Staging dry-run tonight 19:00 UTC. Chao to run and paste logs.

infra-bot: Announcement queued: maint-1770000001. Reminders at 24h and 1h.

chao: Dry-run results: kv-prime 3m, synth queries stable, no errors. Logs: https://internal/logs/1770000001/dryrun

mike: I'll prepare dashboard (p50/p95/p99, error-rate, GPU-util, stream-connects). Alert on error-rate >1.5% for 3m.

nina: Action items:
- chao: staging dry-run (done)
- mike: dashboard + alerts (EOD)
- priya: autoscale cap & budget alert (before window)
- rachel: status + console banner (24h before)

rachel: Draft status note ready. Will include local times and support contacts.

priya: Caps and alerts configured.

mike: Dashboard ready and pinned in ops channel.

nina: If no objections by EOD I'll schedule and ping infra-bot. LGTM?

rachel: LGTM :thumbsup:

chao: LGTM

infra-bot: Notifications sent to #customers-status and on-call rotation updated.

nina: Closing loop 1 Follow-up thread for post-maint metrics will be created after completion.
